snippet.title: Diorama Tactics | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Diorama Tactics is a tactical auto-battler where miniature heroes come to life on a handcrafted battlefield.

Build your squad, position your units, and watch your tactics unfold in battle.

Every battlefield is a living diorama, combining the charm of handcrafted miniatures with tactical strategy and automated combat.

Diorama Tactics is currently in development.

🎮 Coming soon on Steam

Developed by JuMi Interactive

#DioramaTactics #AutoBattler #IndieGame
